band.basis: Sum of per-m² rates: carpet removal 15.9 + standard preparation 33.8–50.0 + LVP supply/lay 42.6–59.0 = 92.3–124.9 $/m². For the full 150 m² office: $13,845 – $18,735 (Auckland, GST-exclusive). Excludes carpet disposal, repairs beyond standard prep, furniture moving, skirting/trim. Confidence medium: LVP has no exact QV row (tile proxy used with stated gauge widening) and the extent of floor preparation is undecided.

Sum of four distinct components for 150 m2: carpet removal 15.9/m2 + floor preparation 33.8-50/m2 + LVP supply and install 42.6-59/m2 + minor sundries allowance (500-1500 total). Low $14,345, high $20,235 for the 150 m2 office. GST exclusive, NZD, QV CostBuilder unreviewed library rates, Auckland centre (WLG prep and CHC removal differ marginally). Confidence medium because the LVP rate is a stated tile-for-plank proxy and the extent of floor preparation is an assumption, not a surveyed quantity.

band.unit: NZD per m² of office floor area (Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no double counting: carpet removal 15.9–19.4 + adhesive/grind prep allowance 8–20 + QV levelling compound 33.8–50 + LVP material 40–100 + LVP install 35–50 + sundries allowance 2–5 = 134.7–244.4 per m², i.e. about $20,200–$36,700 for the 150 m² office. Priced on: standard preparation sufficient; carpet disposal excluded (add roughly $5–7/m² if required); furniture moving and skirting/trim excluded. The band is wide and confidence low because the dominant item (LVP supply and install, ~56–61% of the total) rests on a supplier's general NZ market guide rather than a QV row, and because the specified plank grade, wear layer and install method (glue-down vs floating click) are undecided. Allowances are only ~$10–25/m², under a third of the total. Firm up with a flooring subcontractor's measured quote.

Sum of the four components above, all per m2, no item counted twice: 15.9 (carpet lift/remove, QV) + 4.0-9.0 (adhesive/staple scrape, allowance) + 33.8-79.0 (levelling compound/skim, QV) + 42.6-64.0 (LVP supply and lay, QV tile proxy) = $96.3-167.9/m2. For the pinned 150 m2: low $14,445, centre $19,815, high $25,185 (Auckland, GST exclusive). Wellington: removal row 16.6 and levelling 28.7-74 give ~$99-$162/m2; Christchurch: removal row 19.4 and levelling 33.1-78 give ~$102-$170/m2. Excluded per the pinned scope: carpet disposal fees, floor repairs beyond standard preparation, furniture moving, skirting/trim. Assumption priced: existing floor is sound and standard preparation (scrape plus patch/thin skim) is sufficient; any full 6 mm screed is at the top of the range. Only one allowance (adhesive scrape, ~4-6% of the total) - the main cost drivers are all on cited QV rows, but the LVP rests on a tile proxy and the plank product is unchosen, hence low confidence.

Sum of per-m2 components at Auckland rates, GST exclusive: removal 15.9 (QV) + preparation 33.8-50.0 (QV) + LVP supply & install 42.6-82.0 (QV rigid vinyl tile 3mm proxy, uplifted for 4.5-5mm rigid-core plank) + sundries allowance 3-6. Equivalent to about $14,300-$23,100 for the full 150 m2 (centre about $18,700). Allowances carry under 5% of the band. Confidence low: the largest component (LVP supply and install) rests on a proxy QV rate with a judgement uplift because QV publishes no luxury vinyl plank row; removal and preparation are firmly published. Excludes carpet disposal, floor repairs beyond standard preparation, furniture moving, skirting and trim.
